ayahOccurrences.text: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَؤُزُّهُمْ is in the derivative form: تَؤُزُّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
أ/ز/ز ʾ–z–z to whiz, to buzz, to hum; to agitate, to shake up, to incite, to stir up.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
تَؤُزُّ taʾuzz and أَزٌّ ʾazz.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَؤُزُّ taʾuzz [imperf. of v. أَزَّ ʾazza, trans.; v. n. أَزٌّ ʾazz] to set in confusion, to stampede, to confuse

(19:83) أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا have you not considered that We let the devils loose on the disbelievers to confuse and incite them [to sin].
